lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are organized in a structured grid posterior to the gill slits, with visible nodes forming approximately 5-6 vertical columns and 4-5 horizontal rows in the central flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of lighter intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating a lattice-like appearance where the highest intensity blobs act as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper lateral surface, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light (dorsal) to dark (ventral) along the linear trajectory.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense, non-uniform distribution of high-luminance spots, with higher frequency on the leading edge and a tapering density toward the trailing edge.
